about: Every file lifted from solarlytics-backend, held to its upstream by backend/tests/test_lift_drift.py (round 7, audit parity-architecture-07). sha256 is the file as last reviewed against its upstream; upstream_sha256 the upstream file at the commit (or at reviewed_upstream) after the rename. Hashes are of the text with LF line ends.

files.why: A local access token names its sign-in's session and is refused once that session has ended (sign-out, a reused refresh token): audit security-roles-09.

Gridlytics' roles (admin, operator, analyst, viewer) and permission table; sessions with their registry, sign-out everywhere and one-time passwords (platform.db schema 2 and 3), the account lockout per account, the founder console's company states: audit security-roles-09/-10, parity-supabase-auth-01/-02/-08, founder-console-08, role-analyst-32, pages-A-02. Schema 4: the access requests the contact page sends the founder (Gridlytics' UX backend asks K2 and K3; the rules and the store are access_requests.py, not lifted); Solarlytics has no contact form, so nothing to port back. Schema 5: the company a line of the founder's audit is of, for the console's Company filter, filled for the lines before from the company's name in them, only a name one company alone has held (Gridlytics' UX K34 and its check; the groups and filters are audit_trail.py, not lifted).

The company role admin makes a Gridlytics administrator; a suspended or pending membership is told its state; a password reset or a disable ends every earlier token: audit founder-console-04, parity-supabase-auth-01/-09, security-roles-09.

Open sessions and sign-out of one or every other, the per-account lockout and Supabase-style sign-in throttling, one-time passwords that open only the password change, notification choices: audit security-roles-09/-10, parity-supabase-auth-01/-02/-08, role-analyst-32, pages-A-02.
A founder session secret shorter than 32 characters is refused; founder sign-out ends the session on the server and a new password ends every session: audit security-roles-12, founder-console-09.

The founder console's Gridlytics lists and actions (companies, people, backups with keys and reports, the scheduler's health), its sign-out everywhere and the secret check: audit founder-console-07/-08/-09/-10/-13/-16, security-roles-12. The founder's audit filtered by kind, company, days and search, with its total and groups, each line with its company (Gridlytics' UX K34).

The founder console's store for Gridlytics' companies, sites and backups (search, paging, suspension, the scheduler's last tick): audit founder-console-01/-03/-05/-07/-08/-09/-10/-11/-12/-13/-16/-18, parity-architecture-06, frontend-states-formats-17. Each company's last backup in the console's lists (Gridlytics' UX K35).
No workspace of before to link: Gridlytics has no legacy users, so the adoption of a user of before is empty (plan Part 10.4).

Gridlytics' demo company, sites and accounts from the templates in demo/, the founder's four settings in the data folder's .env.founder, the demo history's days: audit pages-A-04, tracker-and-docs-21. The founder's audit lines of the demo's companies keep their company (Gridlytics' UX K34).

A copy takes the companies' telemetry files, signing keys and reports, with their counts; a restore puts them back: audit founder-console-01/-12/-13, parity-architecture-11/-16, performance-live-07/-08, frontend-states-formats-17. The daily check removes the requests for access past their keeping before it copies the registry (Gridlytics' UX K2 check; access_requests.py, not lifted); Solarlytics has no contact form. The newest copy of each company's file, the backup folder listed once (Gridlytics' UX K35).

Gridlytics' permissions per role (no member sees costs: a viewer never sees money), manage_sites for an administrator, the sign-in throttling and per-account lockout, the analyst's forecast refresh: audit security-roles-02/-10/-16, tracker-and-docs-03, parity-supabase-auth-08, role-operator-06/-07, pages-C-20/-21.

Keys are bound to a site (edge or partner) and refused on another site's path; scopes reach what their words say; a removed site's keys are revoked: DESIGN_LOG The lift, audit security-roles-07, flow-reports-alerts-members-keys-12/-14/-27.
Every stored result records the engine that computed it (version.stamp()): audit parity-architecture-12.

Re-solves, control actions' re-solves and reports run as jobs (answered at once within the wait, else 202 and a job to read), and a failing run raises the plan_failed alert: audit performance-live-05, parity-architecture-06, follow-up of security-roles-08.

The Limiter class of Solarlytics' routes_accept.py, alone in a module of its own; the rest of that file (Solarlytics' acceptance flow) is not lifted. An upstream change to the file is reviewed for the Limiter only. Each key is kept for its own window when the limiter prunes (Gridlytics' UX K3 check): the API's one limiter holds keys of a minute, of five minutes and of an hour, and a minute's check over a full limiter forgot the longer counts. Solarlytics' routes_accept uses one window per limiter, so nothing to port back unless it shares one across windows.
